description: Pinned PMAdMgr.js error-builder advice on exact st.pubmatic.com/track, selected only with operId=7 and a vadsId key. Other operations, older notices without that marker and adjacent services remain uncovered.

params.name: operId
params.description: The inspected error URL builder emits operation 7. The matching marker scopes this producer profile and does not define other operation meanings.

params.name: p
params.description: Publisher reference is appended unconditionally. Zero, blank, sentinel and opaque values remain accepted; no account or ID-format law is inferred.

params.name: s
params.description: Site reference is appended unconditionally. This producer advisory checks key presence without an inferred ID grammar.

params.name: a
params.description: Ad reference is appended unconditionally. Native zero and blank inputs remain valid producer outputs.

params.name: ts
params.description: Math.round(new Date().valueOf()/1000) produces a signed decimal seconds value. Preserve zero and negative values without a freshness, digit-width or account-clock claim.

params.name: wa
params.description: The builder appends its caller-provided network reference. This remains opaque, including zero and numeric strings.

params.name: vadsId
params.description: The current builder always appends adServingId, whose native default is the string -1 and which may be blank. Presence is the current source-profile discriminator; older notices without it remain unclaimed.

params.name: wc
params.description: A campaign reference is appended when the caller network loosely equals 243. Presence advice is restricted to the canonical wire spelling 243; equivalent numeric strings remain accepted without exhaustive JavaScript coercion claims.

params.name: e
params.description: A truthy explicit event argument selects this carrier. Event values stay open, including string 0 and future event codes.

params.name: er
params.description: Without a truthy explicit event, the builder emits the ERRORCODE macro. Literal vendor error codes and future encodings remain open.

params.name: crId
params.description: Truthy creative reference copied from configuration. Numeric zero is omitted while string 0 is retained; no grammar or requiredness is inferred.

params.name: ucrid
params.description: Truthy universal creative reference copied without a local scalar contract.

params.name: impid
params.description: Truthy impression reference copied without an ID-format or equality rule.

params.name: advertiser_id
params.description: Truthy advertiser reference copied without inferred numeric or account requirements.

params.name: ecpm
params.description: Truthy configuration value copied directly. Numeric zero may be omitted while string 0 is retained; no numeric format or currency law is inferred.

params.name: pmc
params.description: The publisher-consent value is omitted for native numeric -1, while string -1 is retained. This is not an IAB consent alias and no enum or permission policy is inferred.

params.name: isAk
params.description: The inspected builder appends only native numeric 0,1 or 2, which serialize to these exact strings. Absence remains allowed for other source configuration types.

params.name: vc
params.description: The inspected image dispatcher appends its video-client marker 2. Keep optional and open because a pre-dispatch template omits it and other clients remain external context.

rules.message: The inspected error builder emits an e key or an er key. Preserve the carrier from the originating sender; no event/error value or exclusivity law is inferred.
The inspected PMAdMgr error builder constructs an HTTPS tracker URL. This is a producer-profile advisory.

params.name: method
params.description: The inspected dispatcher creates an img element and sets its src, producing a GET capture. No body, content-type or header requirement is inferred.
